spots.name: Mount Susitna
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,255 m (4,118 ft).

spots.name: Alexander Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.

spots.name: Anchorage Coastal WR: Clitheroe Flats
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 150 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L1545636.

spots.name: Jet Watching Viewpoint
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing south. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.
